summary: Orzhov aristocrats combo: free sac outlet, recursive creatures, and overlapping death loops.

tags.name: aristocrats
tags.reason: Sac outlets plus death triggers are the whole engine.

tags.name: combo
tags.reason: Several two- and three-card death loops are the primary wins.

tags.name: sacrifice
tags.reason: Bartolomé, altars, and outlets exist to keep dying on purpose.

tags.name: graveyard
tags.reason: The yard is where loop pieces wait, secondary to dying in play.

tags.name: reanimator
tags.reason: Sun Titan, Animate Dead, and recursion bring the loop pieces back.

tags.name: skeletons
tags.reason: Ozox, Reassembling Skeleton, and skeleton-shaped recursion are a real package.
